behavior: Only strongly identified UUID plus matching mount-root candidates produce hints
Candidate mount ID must match the observed table; multiple locations produce no hint
Offline original registration, cached rows, policy and generation are retained
Native non-UTF8 subdirectory bytes survive relocation
Hints clear on absent candidates, unreadable observations, original-volume return or changed identity
Settings uses the canonical base64 path for an explicit ConfigureRoot then fenced RemoveRoot; full rescan
The observed-location action rechecks the offline original identity and the new registration UUID/mount-root before removing the old root; mismatch retains both registrations
limits: Injected providers; no host mounts changed
Real loopback, physical NTFS unplug/return and installed Settings remain owner-run
Discovery is a cached location hint, not automatic relocation or a presence guarantee
